top_categories.workout_context: Belgian Waffle Ride Cedar City's 60% unroad (gravel/sand/rock), 40% pavement, Sandy forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 117 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Belgian Waffle Ride Cedar City's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.
5,940ft of climbing means repeated surges above threshold. VO2max work is how you survive the fifth climb, not just the first.
At mile 60 of 117, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
51ft/mi means long efforts at or near FTP on every climb. If your threshold cracks at minute 15, you'll walk the rest.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Belgian Waffle Ride Cedar City, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
At Belgian Waffle Ride Cedar City, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Belgian Waffle Ride Cedar City. Train it until it feels boring.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on fast-rolling gravel with hidden treachery. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 117 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 5,940ft of climbing on fast-rolling gravel with hidden treachery does to your power file on race day.
5,940ft of climbing on grades that change every minute. You need to switch from seated to standing without losing rhythm.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Belgian Waffle Ride Cedar City’s 117 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Moderate altitude at Belgian Waffle Ride Cedar City. Arrive 2–3 days early. Reduce intensity expectations by 5–10%. Hydrate aggressively.
race_overlay.terrain: Highly technical terrain at Belgian Waffle Ride Cedar City demands practice on similar surfaces. Ride fast-rolling gravel with hidden treachery at race-day cadence weekly. Expect: 60% unroad (gravel/sand/rock), 40% pavement, sandy washboard sectors, packed-dirt rollers. Practice cornering, descending, and power delivery on unstable surfaces. Dial in tire pressure before race week — 5 PSI wrong costs you 15+ minutes over 117 miles.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Gravel Specific, Race Simulation, and VO2max to prepare you for 117 miles of fast-rolling gravel with hidden treachery in Cedar City, Utah.
